description: This Java class 'WorkEffortWorker' provides utility methods for handling work effort entities, including retrieving lowest level work efforts and removing duplicates.

classes.name: WorkEffortWorker
classes.description: Final class providing static utility methods for work effort operations.

methods.name: getLowestLevelWorkEfforts
methods.description: Retrieves the lowest level work efforts associated with a given work effort ID and association type, with optional parameters for left and right keys.

methods.name: getLowestLevelWorkEfforts (overloaded)
methods.description: Internal method that performs the recursive retrieval of work efforts based on specified left and right keys.

methods.name: removeDuplicateWorkEfforts
methods.description: Removes duplicate work efforts from a list based on workEffortId.
